# Vendored Apache Ossie schema

`ossie-schema.json` is `core-spec/ossie-schema.json` from the Apache Ossie repository, unmodified. `LICENSE` is that repository's Apache-2.0 licence text at the same commit.

- Source: https://github.com/apache/ossie/blob/d13bb6a534a100e792a048dd7a14d4d37c723b2c/core-spec/ossie-schema.json
- Commit: `d13bb6a534a100e792a048dd7a14d4d37c723b2c`
- Specification version: `0.2.0.dev0`

To bump it, fetch both files at the new commit and update the commit above.
